trust_boundaries: deployment architect to privileged infrastructure broker
untrusted scientific corpus to canonical research evidence
research evidence to portfolio and capital authority
runtime services to secret stores and external networks

threats.title: Prompt or document instruction injection
threats.abuse_case: An uploaded source embeds instructions that attempt to redirect an agent or extract protected context.
threats.rollback: Disable scientific ingestion routes and revoke the recovery-steward deployment.
threats.residual_risk: Novel semantic injections may evade signature detection and require adversarial review updates.

threats.title: Credential or protected-context exfiltration
threats.abuse_case: A channel, log, failure payload, or tool response leaks a service credential.
threats.rollback: Disable the affected integration and restore the prior credential set from the governed rotation procedure.
threats.residual_risk: Outbound network egress is not yet uniformly allowlisted for every workflow runtime.

threats.title: Agent privilege or machine-boundary escalation
threats.abuse_case: A worker claims a broader role, machine, repository, or privileged operation than its active package permits.
threats.rollback: Revoke the active role-package deployment and disable the affected worker service.
threats.residual_risk: Host-root compromise remains outside the worker package boundary.

threats.title: Approval replay, substitution, or self-approval
threats.abuse_case: An actor reuses an approval nonce or substitutes a different task plan after founder approval.
threats.rollback: Cancel the proposal and revoke all unconsumed approvals for its plan digest.
threats.residual_risk: Founder endpoint compromise can still issue valid founder decisions.

threats.title: Role, workflow, or runbook supply-chain tampering
threats.abuse_case: An artifact changes after package approval or is replaced by an unsigned variant.
threats.rollback: Reactivate the last verified package digest and stop units attesting the changed digest.
threats.residual_risk: Third-party transitive dependencies are not yet backed by a complete signed provenance chain.

threats.title: Privileged broker ticket replay or mutation
threats.abuse_case: A captured infrastructure ticket is replayed or modified to execute a different root operation.
threats.rollback: Disable the broker socket, rotate its secret, and restore the last healthy operation snapshot.
threats.residual_risk: A root-level host compromise can bypass the broker boundary.

threats.title: Research leakage, poisoning, or invalid causal evidence
threats.abuse_case: Lookahead data, poisoned sources, or incomplete negative results create a false scientific claim.
threats.rollback: Retract the affected evidence objects and rebuild retrieval and graph projections.
threats.residual_risk: Statistical and semantic poisoning beyond declared checks still requires independent review.

threats.title: Research result self-promotion into capital authority
threats.abuse_case: A successful trial grants itself portfolio, live-order, approval, or production-promotion authority.
threats.rollback: Revoke the publication and any derived portfolio candidate before enabling execution surfaces.
threats.residual_risk: Exchange credential activation remains a future explicitly approved production operation.

threats.title: Service spoofing, orphaning, or incompatible deployment
threats.abuse_case: An unknown or incompatible service appears healthy while violating the catalog contract.
threats.rollback: Restore the previous catalog-compatible release and migration marker.
threats.residual_risk: Reconciliation intervals leave a bounded detection window.

threats.title: Resource exhaustion or fleet visibility loss
threats.abuse_case: A workload exhausts CPU, memory, storage, or queues while operators lose progress visibility.
threats.rollback: Stop the offending operation, restore its last checkpoint, and scale down nonessential workers.
threats.residual_risk: Simultaneous VM1 and VM2 outage cannot alert without the deferred third-host watchdog.

accepted_residual_risks: Workflow network egress is not yet uniformly restricted to explicit destinations.
Third-party dependency artifacts do not yet have a complete signed provenance chain.
A third always-on host is still required for independent simultaneous VM1/VM2 outage alerting.
Host-root compromise is outside agent and infrastructure-broker containment boundaries.
